senses.gloss:
प्यै प्यै, and प्याय् प्यय् (developed out of vedic पी), i. 1, Ātm. To be exuberant, to increase.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. प्यान.
 II. पीन, Fat, bulky, corpulent, Rām. 1, 1, 13.
 III. प्यायित.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To increase, MBh. 14, 989.
 2. To cause to prosper, 5, 508. आपीन, Full, abounding in milk, MBh. 1, 3934. n. An udder, Ragh. 2, 18.
 --Caus. प्यायय,
 1. To augment, MBh. 3, 13542.
 2. To nourish, Lass. 59, 14.
 3. To refresh, Megh. 45.
 5. To encourage, MBh. 12, 10148. आप्यायित, Fattened, strengthened, Pañc. 9, 4.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To increase.
 --Caus. To refresh, to animate, MBh. 3, 8725.
 --Akin are probably A.S. faett; O.H.G. feizt.
